method: Read-only SELECT id, code, label_en, description FROM public.claim_types ORDER BY id

rows.description: X happened.
Person A did X.
A said X.
A commanded X.
A prohibited X.
X occurred N times / involved N people.
A possessed characteristic X.
X happened because of Y.
Doing X results in Y.
X will happen.
God does/wants X.
States that X ought to be respected, or that a right, duty, obligation, or normative status exists -- without itself being a grammatical command.
A quoted first-person statement attributed to a specific speaker in the source text.
A narrator's report that someone said something, without full direct quotation.
A narrator's report that someone performed/ordered an action -- the report itself, not an endorsed historical fact.
A narrator's description of what happened, distinct from any normative characterization of it.
Editorial voice of the collection's compiler (e.g. Abu Dawud's or Tirmidhi's own notes), distinct from transmitted report content.
Supplies identity of a person/place/entity not explicitly named in the source text.
What a specific word or phrase means.
Rests on a specific grammatical/syntactic parsing.
What event occurred, beyond what the text states.
Why something is theologically significant.
An argument explaining an apparent tension between two textual statements, distinct from a direct classification claim.

r01_narrative_decision.rationale: Ali's transmitted revelation-setting narrative describes what happened; no independent historicity or normative endorsement inferred.
